title: DeepSeek Reasoner Model Support
description: Aider added support for DeepSeek Reasoner model, expanding AI model options for developers.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor announced Google Workspace Plugins integration, extending the IDE's capabilities to work with Google's productivity tools suite.

title: New Model Support (Claude 4.5/4.6, Gemini 2.5/3, GPT-5.1-5.4)
description: Aider added Claude 4.5/4.6 models, expanded Gemini support with 2.5 Flash/Flash-Lite and Gemini 3 preview, and added GPT-5.1 through 5.4 variant support.

title: Stacked Pull Requests Public Preview
description: GitHub launched stacked pull requests in public preview, changing how developers handle related code changes.

title: GitHub Models Retirement
description: GitHub Models was fully retired on July 30, 2026, marking the end of the standalone service.

title: CodeQL 2.26.1 Release
description: GitHub released CodeQL 2.26.1 with improved analysis accuracy and bug fixes.

title: Cursor on iPad
description: Cursor released support for iPad, bringing the AI-powered coding environment to tablet devices.

title: Cursor Start
description: Cursor introduced Cursor Start, a new feature designed to help developers quickly initialize projects.

title: Grok 4.5 Model Support
description: GitHub Copilot added support for Grok 4.5 model, expanding AI model options for developers.

title: /ok Command Shortcut
description: Aider added /ok as a shortcut for accepting proposed changes with optional instructions.

title: Claude Opus 5 Model Support
description: GitHub Copilot added support for Claude Opus 5 model to its AI model lineup.

title: Repo Map Language Expansion
description: Aider's repo map now supports additional languages: Fortran, Haskell, Julia, and Zig.

title: GitHub Code Quality GA
description: GitHub Code Quality became generally available, featuring organization-level targeting and license estimation capabilities.

title: Cursor Router
description: Cursor launched Cursor Router, a new feature for managing and routing development workflows.

title: Git Repo File Addition
description: When auto-commits are disabled, Aider can now add files outside the git repo.
